name: Market One
notes: Photo 1 (digital signage board) and photo 2 (printed 3-panel menu) show overlapping Breakfast, Sandwich and Kids items under the same names but with different prices (e.g. Egg White Wrap $15 vs $12, Grass Fed Burger $21 vs $16) -- this hotel restaurant appears to run two price tiers (Market vs One / different dayparts). Used photo 1's digital-board prices for the overlapping items and added photo 2's unique sections (Coffee & Tea, Blended, Flatbread, Pulled Pork sandwich, 5-9pm dinner plates) without duplicating. Photos 3 and 4 are two different photos of the same 'Cold Food' deli case sign with conflicting item names and prices (older vs newer version); used photo 4 (clearer, less glare) and skipped photo 3 as the duplicate/outdated version. QR-code mobile-order graphics and dietary-key legend were skipped.
